items.t: UPS and FedEx both set 5.9% for 2027; UPS notice is shorter
items.body: UPS's 2027 general rate increase averages 5.9%, announced Oct. 23, 2026 and effective Dec. 21, 2026; FedEx's also averages 5.9%, announced Sept. 18, 2026 and effective Jan. 4, 2027. Both carriers also averaged 5.9% for 2024, 2025 and 2026, after 4.9% in 2018 and 6.9% in 2023. UPS's 2026 increase was announced Oct. 31, 2025 and took effect Dec. 22, 2025, and its 2019 increase was announced Dec. 5, 2018 and took effect Dec. 26, 2018, about 3 weeks' notice.

items.t: UPS surcharges rise faster than the 5.9% average again
items.body: An analysis published Nov. 6, 2026 says all 20 of the most common UPS surcharges rise more than 5.9%, averaging 9.1%, effective Dec. 21, 2026. Ground residential goes to $7.10 from $6.50, after $6.10 to $6.50 in the 2026 increase and $4.45 to $4.85 in the 2022 increase. The Additional Handling minimum billable weight moves to 50 lb from 40 lb, the 40 lb minimum having been added with the 2025 increase.

items.t: Peak fees step up on 2025 levels; USPS peak sits on the 8%
items.body: For the Nov. 23 to Dec. 27, 2026 window, FedEx lists Ground residential at $0.80 (vs $0.65 in 2025) and Additional Handling at $11.85 (vs $10.90). UPS lists Large Package at $117.50 (vs $107 in 2025) and Over Maximum Limits at $590 (vs $540). USPS retail Priority Mail and Ground Advantage Zones 1-4, 0-3 lb carry +$0.50, against +$0.40 in 2025 and +$0.30 in 2024, and this year's peak runs alongside the temporary 8% increase.

items.t: Fuel surcharges near 29%, up from the 20% reached in 2025
items.body: In June 2025 UPS and FedEx Ground fuel surcharges both reached 20%, a record at the time; the previous peak was FedEx at 19.50% in mid-2022. Reuters, citing company tables at a $6.28 diesel average, put UPS at 29.5% and FedEx at 29% in October 2026. UPS's table effective Nov. 2, 2026 charges 0.50 point more than the old one at the same diesel price, and FedEx's tables effective Nov. 9 run from 30.00% to 31.50% for Ground; UPS's other 2026 domestic table changes took effect Jan. 5, Mar. 9 and Aug. 10.

items.t: USPS 2026 adds a temporary 8% and a July change to the usual two
items.body: USPS's January 2026 change, effective Jan. 18, 2026, raised Priority Mail about 6.6% and Ground Advantage about 7.8%, against 3.2% and 3.9% in January 2025. A temporary 8% base-postage increase, announced Mar. 25, 2026, took effect Apr. 26 and runs through Jan. 17, 2027. July changes also came in 2024 (Parcel Select +25%) and 2025 (Priority Mail +6.3%, Ground Advantage +7.1%); in July 2026 Ground Advantage Commercial rose an average 11.8% as ounce tiers were removed.

items.t: New in 2026: USPS fuel surcharge, UPS origin-ZIP fee, import fees
items.body: USPS announced Oct. 26, 2026 a weekly fuel surcharge on four package services starting January 2027; in January 2021 USPS had noted no fuel, residential or regular Saturday delivery surcharges. UPS announced Oct. 23 a new origin-ZIP surcharge on Ground and Ground Saver for Qualified customers, effective Dec. 21, 2026 or later with the amount not released, and a 5% fuel surcharge on Small Business Rates. FedEx added per-pound U.S. import demand fees on Nov. 2, 2026 ($0.36 and $0.27 for Vietnam; Europe and Israel $0.25 to $0.28), where 2025 international peak fees ran $0.10 to $0.52 per lb.
